name: lock_server_sync-r1
cmd: GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 90 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only lock_server_sync --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/e.log >/tmp/o.log; echo lock_server_sync $(grep -o '"search":{"verdict":"[a-z]*"' /tmp/o.log) $(grep -o '"ms":[0-9]*}}' /tmp/o.log) $(grep -o '"error".\{0,200\}' /tmp/o.log); grep -E 'join (pool|failed)' /tmp/e.log | cut -c1-300
